text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Faced with Nishino Flower's blazing
speed, 
Sakura Bakushin O tasted defeat and was 
thrown into utter disarray by the 
unexpected outcome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, the title of Class Rep will 
be stolen away...
Fearful of that outcome, 
she set her sights on the
"Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen" to defeat Nishino Flower once and 
for all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O politely declared war
on 
Nishino Flower, telling her to wash her 
neck and await her defeat.
